title: Residential Property Condition Disclosure
description: Tennessee Code Annotated §66-5-202 requires sellers of residential real property (1-4 units) to provide a completed Tennessee Residential Property Condition Disclosure form to the buyer. The disclosure covers the seller's actual knowledge of defects in structural, mechanical, plumbing, electrical, environmental, and other systems. The form must be provided before acceptance of a purchase offer.

required_actions.note: Must be provided before acceptance of an offer. Buyer may rescind within 3 days of receipt if disclosure reveals material defects not previously known.

title: Agency Disclosure and Confirmation
description: Tennessee requires real estate licensees to provide written disclosure of agency relationships at the first reasonable opportunity. Dual agency requires written informed consent from both buyer and seller. Tennessee recognizes designated agency within a firm. The Tennessee Real Estate Broker License Act of 1973 as amended governs agency relationships.

required_actions.note: Confirmation of agency must be in writing prior to offer. Dual agency consent must be documented.

title: Closing Practice — Title Company or Attorney
description: Tennessee is not an attorney-close state. Closings are typically handled by title companies, escrow companies, or attorneys. The state follows a deed of trust system for secured real estate transactions rather than traditional mortgages.

required_actions.note: Title company or attorney handles closing. Deed of trust system used in lieu of mortgage.

title: Lead-Based Paint Disclosure (Pre-1978)
description: Federal law requires disclosure of known lead-based paint hazards for residential properties built before 1978. Tennessee follows federal requirements under 42 U.S.C. §4852d. Sellers must provide the EPA pamphlet and allow a 10-day inspection contingency.

title: Real Estate Advertising Compliance
description: Tennessee Real Estate Commission rules require that all real estate advertising include the name of the brokerage firm as licensed. Individual agents may not advertise independently without firm identification. Team names must include the brokerage firm name. All advertising must be truthful and not misleading under TCA §62-13-312.

required_actions.note: All advertising must include brokerage firm name as licensed. No blind ads permitted.
